name: water can
_note: stays when the water is gone; 'fill' at a water source you have explored (the spring, the river)

actions.label: fill
log: You hold the can in the spring until it brims.
Cold water gurgles into the can.
You fill the can to the top and screw the lid on tight.

actions.label: fill
log: You hold the can under the river's surface until it stops bubbling.
The current pushes river water into the can.
You fill the can in the river and screw the lid on tight.
